rationale: With only 19 minutes to close, BETR is sitting at 97.6% of its intraday range after a massive gap-up (+4.51%) on elevated relative volume (3.11x), leaving almost no room for a long entry without being immediately at the day's high. A short against a stock showing this kind of momentum with a pending securities class action (which could attract continued speculative buying) carries asymmetric risk in a thin float. The 1-minute candles show low volume and tight consolidation near the high with no clear directional catalyst, making the risk/reward insufficient to justify a position this close to forced liquidation.
